name: srs-fretboard
description: Client-side SRS fretboard trainer: AudioWorklet YIN pitch detection + ts-fsrs scheduling, with optional Cloudflare D1 progress sync.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute fretboard_progress --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute fretboard_progress --local --file=./migrations/0002_composite_key.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute fretboard_progress --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute fretboard_progress --remote --file=./migrations/0002_composite_key.sql
